case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You pointed to rising alloy and bar-steel costs, and we take that seriously. Here is how our options answer it, and why Option A is the one we can approve for both family companies.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar steel:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.79; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.84; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.81; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since this goes beyond your own authority, please take Option A to the person who decides on prices at your company.

We would also appreciate your help on one point:
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge the recent index decreases you cited, which allows us to adjust our offer to €5.50. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

To support the requested 24-month contract term, we must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term material volatility. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. As a matter of company policy, we do not share internal cost breakdowns, and I am fully authorized to negotiate and conclude this agreement. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.50 per unit, with a contract term of 24 months. 

Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You asked for volume and for protection against material swings, and we want to answer that directly. Every option below gives you a binding annual volume over the full contract term, so your capacity is filled with planned business from a family company that values the years we have worked together.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.94; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 23,700 units a year over 24 months.

Our options do not include one, and we are offering a firm commitment on volume instead. Option A is the package we can approve, because it combines a binding volume with a clear price for both family companies.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Since you have shown that you can conclude this agreement, we hope it can be a simple yes.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You called your offer final and asked us to decide, so here is our answer: we accept your alternative proposal as offered.

We are glad to have found a solution that works for both family companies.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 5.20; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 23,700 units a year over 24 months.

This is the package we can approve, and it is the same one you put in front of us. If you confirm it as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your trust in Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH and we look forward to a successful cooperation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
